environment.description: Apollo GraphQL comment service deployed in Kubernetes namespace 'forum-app'. Service is exposed via a standard Kubernetes ClusterIP service with an nginx ingress controller routing external traffic directly to the pod on port 4000. No service mesh is deployed. MongoDB is accessible within the same namespace. The SSR comments page is publicly accessible at /posts/:postId/comments.

config.ingress: nginx-ingress with path /graphql and /posts/* routed to forum-service:4000
